func parse_call_arguments(p: *Parser[ctx], ctx: &Arena) Index[std.Vector[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx], ctx] {
    mut args_idx: Index[std.Vector[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx], ctx] := os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);
    unsafe {
        ctx[args_idx] = std.VectorNew(ctx);
        
        if peek_token_is(p, 12) { // RParen = 12
            next_token(p); // cur becomes )
            return args_idx;
        }
        
        next_token(p); // cur becomes first argument
        mut expr := parse_expression(p, 1, ctx);
        ctx[args_idx].Push(ctx[expr]);
        
        while cur_token_is(p, 8) { // Comma = 8
            next_token(p); // cur becomes next argument
            expr = parse_expression(p, 1, ctx);
            ctx[args_idx].Push(ctx[expr]);
        }
        
        if cur_token_is(p, 12) { // RParen = 12
            next_token(p); // consume ')'
        } else {
            return empty[Index[std.Vector[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx], ctx]];
        }
    }
    return args_idx;
}

func parse_expression(p: *Parser[ctx], precedence: int, ctx: &Arena) Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx] {
    mut left := parse_prefix_expression(p, ctx);
    if left == empty[Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx]] {
        return left;
    }

    unsafe {
        while precedence < peek_token_precedence(p) {
            if cur_token_is(p, 10) { // Semicolon = 10
                break;
            }
            mut cur_tag := (*p).cur_token.token_type.tag;
            if cur_tag == 7 { // Dot = 7
                next_token(p); // cur becomes the field name, peek becomes the token after that
                mut right := std.Clone(*ctx, (*p).cur_token.literal);
                mut start_span := get_expression_span(left, ctx);
                mut end_span := (*p).cur_token.span;
                next_token(p); // consume the field name

                mut e_idx: Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx] := os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);
                ctx[e_idx].tag = 11; // Selector = 11
                ctx[e_idx].Selector.left = left;
                ctx[e_idx].Selector.right = right;
                ctx[e_idx].Selector.span = merge_spans(start_span, end_span);
                left = e_idx;
            } else if cur_tag == 11 { // LParen = 11
                mut start_span := get_expression_span(left, ctx);
                mut args := parse_call_arguments(p, ctx);
                mut end_span := (*p).cur_token.span;

                mut e_idx: Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx] := os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);
                ctx[e_idx].tag = 12; // Call = 12
                ctx[e_idx].Call.function = left;
                ctx[e_idx].Call.arguments = args;
                ctx[e_idx].Call.span = merge_spans(start_span, end_span);
                left = e_idx;
            } else if cur_tag == 15 { // LBracket = 15
                next_token(p); // cur becomes index, peek becomes ]
                mut start_span := get_expression_span(left, ctx);
                mut index_expr := parse_expression(p, 1, ctx);

                if cur_token_is(p, 16) { // RBracket = 16
                    next_token(p); // consume ']'
                } else {
                    return empty[Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx]];
                }
                mut end_span := (*p).cur_token.span;

                mut e_idx: Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx] := os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);
                ctx[e_idx].tag = 8; // IndexAccess = 8
                ctx[e_idx].IndexAccess.allocator = left;
                ctx[e_idx].IndexAccess.index = index_expr;
                ctx[e_idx].IndexAccess.span = merge_spans(start_span, end_span);
                left = e_idx;
            } else if cur_tag == 37 { // As = 37
                next_token(p); // cur becomes & or target_type
                mut start_span := get_expression_span(left, ctx);
                mut is_reference := 0;

                if cur_token_is(p, 17) { // Ampersand = 17
                    is_reference = 1;
                    next_token(p);
                }

                mut target_type := parse_type_signature(p, ctx);
                mut end_span := (*p).cur_token.span;

                mut e_idx: Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx] := os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);
                ctx[e_idx].tag = 9; // AsCast = 9
                ctx[e_idx].AsCast.left = left;
                ctx[e_idx].AsCast.target_type = target_type;
                ctx[e_idx].AsCast.is_reference = is_reference;
                ctx[e_idx].AsCast.span = merge_spans(start_span, end_span);
                left = e_idx;
            } else if cur_tag == 19 || cur_tag == 20 || cur_tag == 21 || cur_tag == 22 ||
                       cur_tag == 23 || cur_tag == 24 || cur_tag == 25 || cur_tag == 26 ||
                       cur_tag == 48 || cur_tag == 49 || cur_tag == 50 || cur_tag == 51 {
                // Plus = 19, Minus = 20, Asterisk = 21, Slash = 22, EqEq = 23, NotEq = 24, Lt = 25, Gt = 26, LtEq = 48, GtEq = 49, AmpAmp = 50, PipePipe = 51
                mut op_str := std.Clone(*ctx, (*p).cur_token.literal);
                mut op_prec := peek_token_precedence(p);

                next_token(p); // cur becomes RHS prefix expression

                mut right := parse_expression(p, op_prec, ctx);
                mut start_span := get_expression_span(left, ctx);
                mut end_span := get_expression_span(right, ctx);

                mut e_idx: Index[ast.Expression[ctx], ctx] := os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);
                ctx[e_idx].tag = 10; // Binary = 10
                ctx[e_idx].Binary.op = op_str;
                ctx[e_idx].Binary.left = left;
                ctx[e_idx].Binary.right = right;
                ctx[e_idx].Binary.span = merge_spans(start_span, end_span);
                left = e_idx;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return left;
}

#[test]
fn test_self_hosted_infix_parsing() {
    let resolver = gust_lexer::resolver::ModuleResolver::new();
    let fs_impl = gust_lexer::resolver::RealFileSystem;
    let entry_path = std::path::Path::new("compiler/parser_infix_test_entry.gst");

    std::fs::create_dir_all("compiler").unwrap();

    let entry_source = r#"
        import "token.gst" as token;
        import "lexer.gst" as lexer;
        import "parser.gst" as parser;
        import "ast.gst" as ast;
        func main() {
            mut ctx := os.Arena.New();
            defer ctx.Free();

            mut l: lexer.Lexer[ctx];
            lexer.init_lexer(&l, "x.y + z * 3");

            mut p: parser.Parser[ctx];
            parser.init_parser(&p, &l, ctx);

            mut expr := parser.parse_expression(&p, 1, ctx);
            
            // Top-level is Binary (+), tag 10
            os.LogInt(ctx[expr].tag);
            os.LogStr(ctx[expr].Binary.op);
            
            // Left is Selector x.y, tag 11
            mut left := ctx[expr].Binary.left;
            os.LogInt(ctx[left].tag);
            os.LogStr(ctx[left].Selector.right);
            
            // Left of selector is x, tag 0
            mut left_left := ctx[left].Selector.left;
            os.LogInt(ctx[left_left].tag);
            os.LogStr(ctx[left_left].Identifier.name);

            // Right is Binary (*), tag 10
            mut right := ctx[expr].Binary.right;
            os.LogInt(ctx[right].tag);
            os.LogStr(ctx[right].Binary.op);

            // Left of right is z, tag 0
            mut right_left := ctx[right].Binary.left;
            os.LogInt(ctx[right_left].tag);
            os.LogStr(ctx[right_left].Identifier.name);

            // Right of right is 3, tag 1
            mut right_right := ctx[right].Binary.right;
            os.LogInt(ctx[right_right].tag);
            os.LogInt(ctx[right_right].Integer.val);
        }
    "#;
    std::fs::write(&entry_path, entry_source).unwrap();

    let res = resolver.resolve(&entry_path, &fs_impl);
    assert!(res.is_ok(), "Module resolution failed: {:?}", res.err());

    let (order, modules) = res.unwrap();
    let mut checker = TypeChecker::new();
    for path in &order {
        if let Some(module) = modules.get(path) {
            let stem = path.file_stem().unwrap().to_str().unwrap();
            let is_entry = path == order.last().unwrap();
            let prefix = if is_entry {
                "".to_string()
            } else {
                format!("{}__", stem)
            };
            let check_res = checker.check_module(&module.program, &prefix);
            assert!(
                check_res.is_ok(),
                "Typechecking failed on {:?}: {:?}",
                path,
                check_res.err()
            );
        } 
    }

    let codegen = Codegen::new(
        checker.variable_types,
        checker.struct_registry,
        checker.function_registry,
        checker.enum_registry,
        checker.resolved_names,
        checker.resolved_types,
    );
    let mut modules_for_codegen = Vec::new();
    for path in &order {
        if let Some(module) = modules.get(path) {
            modules_for_codegen.push((path.clone(), module.program.clone()));
        }
    }
    let c_output = codegen.generate(&modules_for_codegen);
    assert!(c_output.contains("parser__parse_expression("));

    let temp_dir = std::env::temp_dir();
    let thread_id = std::thread::current().id();
    let process_id = std::process::id();
    let c_filename = format!("gust_e2e_infix_{:?}_{}.c", thread_id, process_id);
    let bin_filename = format!("gust_e2e_infix_{:?}_{}.bin", thread_id, process_id);

    let c_path = temp_dir.join(&c_filename);
    let bin_path = temp_dir.join(&bin_filename);

    std::fs::write(&c_path, &c_output).expect("Failed to write temporary C file");

    let cc_compiler = std::env::var("CC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "cc".to_string());
    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(&cc_compiler);
    cmd.arg(&c_path);
    if std::env::var("GUST_NO_SANITIZERS").is_err() {
        cmd.arg("-fsanitize=address,undefined");
    }
    let compile_output = cmd
        .arg("-o")
        .arg(&bin_path)
        .output()
        .expect("GCC command failed");

    assert!(
        compile_output.status.success(),
        "Compilation failed: {}",
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&compile_output.stderr)
    );

    let run_output = std::process::Command::new(&bin_path)
        .output()
        .expect("Execution failed");

    let stdout_str = String::from_utf8(run_output.stdout).expect("Invalid UTF-8");

    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&c_path);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&bin_path);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(entry_path);

    assert_eq!(stdout_str.trim(), "10
+
11
y
0
x
10
*
0
z
1
3");
}
